_comment: Feature validation cases shared by tests/test_geometry.py (geometry.validate_room, Python) and tests/builder.test.mjs (builder/state.js featureProblems, JavaScript). Both must give exactly these messages, so the builder's inline errors match what the server says on save. Rooms are 114 x 150 in with a 102 in ceiling unless a case gives an outline.

cases.name: outlet at the very end of a wall
wall below range
expected: Outlet 1 must be on a wall from A to D.

cases.name: wall above range
expected: Outlet 1 must be on a wall from A to D.

cases.name: negative offset
expected: Outlet 1 needs a distance from the corner of 0 in or more.

cases.name: outlet past the end
expected: Outlet 1 is past the end of wall A (115 in on a 114 in wall).

cases.name: missing width
expected: Closet 1 needs a width of 1 in or more.

cases.name: window wider than its wall
expected: Window 1 is wider than wall A (120 in on a 114 in wall).

cases.name: door running past the end
expected: Door 1 runs past the end of wall A (90 + 34 in on a 114 in wall).

cases.name: missing height
expected: Door 1 needs a height of 1 in or more.

cases.name: door taller than the ceiling
expected: Door 1 is taller than the ceiling (103 in under a 102 in ceiling).

cases.name: window without sill
expected: Window 1 needs a sill height of 0 in or more.

cases.name: window above the ceiling
expected: Window 1 reaches above the ceiling (sill 43 in + height 60 in under a 102 in ceiling).

cases.name: radiator depth zero
expected: Radiator 1 needs a depth of 1 in or more.

cases.name: numbering per kind
expected: Window 2 is wider than wall B (200 in on a 150 in wall).

cases.name: width and height both wrong
expected: Door 1 needs a width of 1 in or more.
Door 1 needs a height of 1 in or more.

cases.name: diagonal wall lengths show one decimal
expected: Door 1 is wider than wall B (150 in on a 141.4 in wall).

cases.name: at most 40 features
expected: A room can have at most 40 features.
